description: Dependency updates for Themis. Every commit is signed off for the DCO check.

packageRules.description: Patch and digest updates merge themselves once every check passes. Renovate merges them itself (platformAutomerge is off) so the e2e run, which is not a required check, gates them too.
Kubernetes libraries move together, and only with a controller-runtime that supports them (see the release checklist).
A new Kubernetes minor moves the supported window: CI matrix, kubeVersion, README and kubectl together. Opened only on request from the dependency dashboard.
kubectl stays inside the supported window, so its minor moves with the window too.
A new Postgres major cannot start on the previous major's data directory, so the chart's database moves only on request from the dependency dashboard.
go.mod's go line is the minimum Go version Themis builds with, raised by hand; the toolchain line is updated.
One Go version everywhere: go.mod's toolchain, mise.toml and the build image.
The policy engine changes behaviour on minor versions; review those by hand.
Developer tools run through go tool.
One Trivy version in mise.toml and the Security workflow. After the GitHub Actions group, so it wins for the workflow's copy.
One Python version in .python-version and the intelligence image.
One uv version in mise.toml and the intelligence image.
